excluded.reason: prose documentation outside docs/adr; reviewed by people, not by the model
binary, vector, or property-list assets carry no reviewable source
styling is gated by the SHA-pinned visual-proof and axe gates, not by model review
data, prose, and config outside the review-relevant set above; covered by deterministic gates

catch-all: every remaining path is deliberately outside model review for this repository. It is the last resort, not the routine answer — an executable or trust-boundary tree that lands here is a profile gap, not an exclusion. Inclusion is evaluated before exclusion, so an entry in reviewRelevant always wins over this rule.

benignWarnings.justification: expected on files larger than the model context window; the file is still reviewed in part, and the deterministic gates cover it in full
